name: Transform Airports AI Research Council
purpose: Airport executive reports, board presentations, and technical evidence appendices

layout.density: one decision or claim per slide; no more than 70 visible words unless the slide is explicitly an appendix
layout.composition: flat editorial canvas; avoid dashboard card grids

priority: passenger, aircraft, baggage, curb, or decision flow
visual_language.photography: Use real, licensed airport imagery only when it contributes evidence or place specificity.
visual_language.signature_visual: Every board deck must contain one memorable evidence-bearing visual that explains the central insight.
